motion: Merge PR #70 (feature/38-cli-scaffold-subcommands → main) — 7th review (1v1). Normalize OKLCH color validation across CLI commands.

fixes.description: Normalize OKLCH color validation across run.js, paint.js, and fill.js to a single shared acceptance grammar. The three validators define different acceptance criteria — oklch(50% 0.1 180 200) is ACCEPTED by paint/fill (extra tokens silently dropped) and REJECTED by run (exit 1). Fix options: (a) extract shared parseColor into cli/color-utils.js, (b) apply run.js:14 strict regex as initial gate in paint.js and fill.js, or (c) add parts.length > 3 check to parseOklch in paint.js and fill.js.
